description: An illustrative lung-disease Bayesian-network example with binary variables (0=no, 1=yes). These are example samples, not clinical observations.

variables.visit_to_asia: Whether the person has recently visited Asia.
variables.lung_cancer: Whether the person has lung cancer.
variables.either: Whether tuberculosis or lung cancer is present.
variables.positive_chest_xray: Whether the chest X-ray is positive.
variables.dyspnoea: Whether the person experiences shortness of breath.
